input: My sister Imogen had already booked the venue for Mom's retirement dinner before she told any of us. I said I would have liked to be asked, we argued about it for an hour on the phone, and in the end she moved it to a place I suggested.
It did. I would honestly rather be asked what I think and fight it out than be the one who just goes along. Having a say matters more to me than keeping the peace.
Back from two nights on Pelee Island. The ferry home was so rough that half the deck was green and we sat inside eating crackers.
At dinner tonight Imogen told everyone I am the easiest person in the family, never any fuss. They all laughed and agreed. I know it was meant kindly and I just feel small.
